raw_excerpt: CommonMark (referenced via GFM Spec). 'A rationalized version of Markdown syntax with a spec.' Created by John MacFarlane (jgm), 2014 onwards. Underlying specification for GFM and most modern markdown parsers. 600+ conformance tests. ATX headings (#), Setext headings (=== / ---), indented code blocks (4 spaces), fenced code blocks (3+ backticks or tildes), blockquotes, ordered/unordered lists with various markers, link reference definitions, backslash escapes, hard/soft line breaks. The de facto Markdown standard.
